verdict.rationale: Lever's developer documentation includes an OAuth section, and its integrator sandbox uses its own auth server with separate apps per environment. This suggests app-specific delegated credentials rather than a single shared key, but the pack never shows scopes or permission limits on what an agent's credential can access. missing for 10: documented OAuth scopes or permission levels per credential, evidence of read-only or resource-limited tokens, credential revocation and rotation controls, self-serve credential issuance (access is partner-gated), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: You will have two separate app's, one for each environment
